title: Schedule keeps the visible week selected
eyebrow: Wisconsin Creative · Next-build fix · Local verification
lede: A Schedule that fits on screen keeps today selected. The bottom override applies after scrollable content moves away from the top.

sections.heading: Sparse Schedule, same fixture and viewport
sections.note: Before and after use the same native screen, Volleyball fixture, calendar day, role, filters and initial scroll position. Only the selection state and unnecessary Today button change.

pairs.title: Today remains selected
pairs.beforeCap: Today is visible, but the tracker follows the later empty week. Today appears even at the top.
pairs.afterCap: Today stays selected; the unnecessary Today action is gone.

changes.h: Treat a fitting list as being at the top
changes.was: The bottom check also matched a short list whose first and last rows were both visible.
changes.now: The override requires positive scrollable height and an offset beyond the top inset. Existing last-day focus at the bottom of a longer list is retained.

verification: 235 native tests passed; zero failed or skipped. The new regression fails on the pre-fix behavior.
59 Schedule source-contract checks passed across 13 files.
Simulator build, generic-device build, project drift, pattern drift and 79/79 audit coverage passed.
Sparse Schedule captures passed before and after. A separate long-list UI check scrolled away, tapped Today, and confirmed the Today action disappeared after returning.
Logical viewport measured by the UI test: 440 × 956 pt. Captures are 1320 × 2868 pixels.
notes: Local fix on codex/schedule-week-selection; inclusion in the next distributed build is pending. Submitted App Review build 34 is unchanged.
Fixtures prove native layout and navigation. This check makes no new authenticated-server or physical-device claim.

The device wall clock was not frozen. The compared Volleyball event uses the same 11:00–14:00 calendar-day times and was past in both captures; relative fromNow events were excluded by the same filter. The status-bar clock was overridden to 9:41.
Temporary UI capture code is retained in capture-harness.swift and was removed from the app test source after capture. Hash-bound source snapshots are retained alongside the images.
